result.topic_en: Notes on constructing a function of a complex variable z = x + y\sqrt{-1} whose real part takes prescribed values on the boundaries of three circles, and on counting how often it takes a given value by integrating d log(ζ − a) around the boundary.

items.english: consists in determining a function of a complex variable, for all values lying outside three given circles, such that its real part on the peripheries of these circles equals an arbitrarily given quantity.
